items.statement: The report independently establishes the identity of the deposited HIAM-234b two-net crystal and constructs a one-net comparator without changing the retained net chemistry or cell.
items.expected: CCDC 2478962, net counts 2 and 1, fixed cell, and explicit atom mapping/connectivity validation.

items.statement: The investigation uses comparable fixed-cell solvent-free endpoints and a transparent per-net energy normalization.
items.expected: Method and convergence evidence for both models plus explicit E(2IP)/2 minus E(NIP)/1 normalization.

items.statement: The energy result favors the deposited two-net model over the one-net comparator.
items.expected: A negative 2IP-minus-NIP per-net difference with magnitude consistent with the source-reported 188.3 kcal mol−1 stabilization within the authored tolerance.
